author: cairn
blurb: Surfaces overdue tasks with a suggested next step for each.

definition.name: Overdue nudge
definition.description: Lists overdue tasks and proposes a next step for each (no auto-edits).
definition.instructions: Find overdue tasks in the project. Write an 'Overdue — <date>' note listing them soonest-first with their priority, and for each add a one-line suggested next step (for example: reprioritise, split into smaller tasks, or drop). Do NOT modify any task — recommend only.
